$comment: Source of truth for the 16 Hour-12 twist constraints. Read by .github/workflows/twist-vote.yml to auto-post the vote. If you edit IDs here, mirror them in the TWISTS array in docs/app.js — the config-consistency job checks that the ID sets match.

twists.name: Battery Only
twists.rule: Must run on a single CR2032 or AA cell. No wall power, no USB power bank.

twists.name: Solar Powered
twists.rule: Must function solely on ambient light energy harvesting. No backup battery.

twists.name: 5mW Budget
twists.rule: Total average device power consumption cannot exceed 5mW. Document your power budget.

twists.name: No WiFi
twists.rule: Remove all WiFi/internet connectivity. BLE or LoRa communication only.

twists.name: Offline Only
twists.rule: No cloud, no app, no phone. All sensing, logic, and output must be local to the device.

twists.name: One-Wire Output
twists.rule: The only output to the user is a single LED or a single buzzer. Nothing else.

twists.name: No Screws
twists.rule: Enclosure must be entirely tool-free: snap fits, press fits, magnets, or friction only.

twists.name: 100mm Cube Max
twists.rule: The entire assembled device, including external sensors and antennas, must fit inside a 100x100x100mm cube.

twists.name: Repurposed Enclosure
twists.rule: The housing must reuse an existing household object (tin, pill bottle, jar). Document what you used.

twists.name: $15 BOM Cap
twists.rule: Total bill of materials, including PCB and enclosure, cannot exceed $15 USD. Include a priced BOM.

twists.name: 3-Component Rule
twists.rule: Active component count (ICs, MCUs, modules, sensors) is capped at 3 total.

twists.name: No Microcontroller
twists.rule: Core logic must use discrete analog circuitry only: 555 timers, op-amps, comparators, transistors. No MCU, no FPGA.

twists.name: Add Accessibility
twists.rule: Must be fully operable by someone with limited or no vision, or limited hand mobility. Document the accessibility features.

twists.name: Child Safe
twists.rule: Safe for unsupervised use around children under 5. No exposed conductors, all voltages under 5V, no sharp edges, no small parts.

twists.name: Rental Friendly
twists.rule: Cannot attach permanently to any surface. No adhesives, no screws into walls, no drilled holes.

twists.name: Fail Safe Mode
twists.rule: On any power loss or system failure, the device must automatically transition to a defined safe state. Document the behavior.
